contract: A wide generator export is ONE quantity for every generator it lists, named on the file's title line: "Generator Hourly 'Generation (MWh)' Data for Year 2035". `temporal` says how HOURS combine. `class` says how GENERATORS combine, and `spatialOf` in src/tables/generator/rules.ts reads it: EXTENSIVE and RATE sum across generators, INTENSIVE refuses, and so does a unit with no rule. That decides whether a grouped generator row sums or refuses and which quantities the Generator Groups tab offers, whether the group is a lookup join or an injection group the user authored. Editing `class` changes what that tab shows. Resolution: exact match on `unit` (case-sensitive), else no rule -- an unrecognised unit gets MEAN and no total, never a guess. `quantities` records the columns this exporter has been seen to emit; `isPolysemous` and `quantityNote` in src/tables/generator/rules.ts read it, and tests/test_kernels_generator.mjs fails any entry that neither resolves to a unit ruled on above nor is flagged `polysemous`.

units.note: MW is a rate. Summed over a filtered set of hours it is neither MW nor MWh, so no total is offered.
The LMP at the generator's bus is a price: intensive, and not summable over hours.

quantities.note: One column whose meaning depends on the unit's technology: fuel cost for a thermal unit, storage state for an energy-storage unit. Carried verbatim, never split at ingest; a pane that totals it says what it is totalling.
Startup fuel for a thermal unit, spillage for hydro, pump line for pumped storage.
Secondary fuel consumption for a thermal unit, pumping cost for pumped storage.
